COOKIE_CONSENT.DESCRIPTION: StrollBar uses necessary storage to keep the service secure and remember your session. Optional cookies help us remember preferences or understand usage, and are only enabled with your consent.

IMPRINT.TITLE: Imprint
IMPRINT.OPERATOR_BODY: StrollBar is operated by Peter Ciprian. StrollBar is an independent project for discovering story-led walking tours in Budapest.
IMPRINT.CONTACT_BODY: For questions about StrollBar, please contact the developer through the official GitHub profile linked in the footer. The operator's postal address and tax details must be added here before a commercial public launch.
IMPRINT.RESPONSIBLE_BODY: The operator is responsible for the content published through StrollBar within the scope required by applicable law. External links lead to third-party websites whose content is outside the operator's control.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.SCOPE_BODY: This policy explains how StrollBar processes information when you browse public strolls, create an account, or use an authenticated adventure.
PRIVACY.DATA_BODY: Depending on how you use the service, this may include your username, email address, password hash, profile image, authentication tokens, stroll progress, answers, achievements, and technical request information.
PRIVACY.PURPOSE_BODY: We use information to create and secure accounts, authenticate users, provide stroll and achievement features, protect the service, and respond to support requests. We do not use passwords in readable form.
PRIVACY.PROVIDERS_BODY: The service may use PostgreSQL for application data, S3-compatible storage for media, Render for backend hosting, GitHub Pages for frontend hosting, and social login providers when you choose that option. Each provider may process data under its own terms.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BODY: We retain account and progress information while it is needed to provide the service or meet legal obligations. We use hashed passwords, signed tokens, access controls, and encrypted transport, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_BODY: Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information. Contact the developer through GitHub to submit a request.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of Service
TERMS.SERVICE_BODY: StrollBar provides a digital platform for discovering and playing story-led walking tours. Features may change as the project develops.
TERMS.ACCOUNTS_BODY: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials private and for activity performed through your account. Provide accurate information and notify the operator if you believe your account has been compromised.
TERMS.CONTENT_BODY: Tour descriptions, riddles, media, and other materials are provided for entertainment and orientation. Check local conditions, opening hours, traffic, weather, and accessibility before starting a stroll.
TERMS.ACCEPTABLE_USE_BODY: Do not misuse the service, bypass authentication, interfere with its operation, upload unlawful or harmful content, or use it in a way that puts yourself or others at risk.
TERMS.AVAILABILITY_BODY: The service is provided on an as-available basis. The operator is not responsible for interruption, inaccurate third-party information, route hazards, or decisions made while following a tour. Use reasonable care and follow local rules.
TERMS.CHANGES_BODY: These terms may be updated as the service changes. The latest version will be published on this page, with the update date shown above. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
